units.source_text: “现在的千重子小姐是佐田先生的掌上明珠，

en.t: The Chieko we know now is Mr. Sada's treasured darling,

units.source_text: 是他精心把千重子小姐抚养成人的啊。”

en.t: and he is the one who raised Miss Chieko with such care until she grew up."

units.source_text: 真一说，“那个时候，哥哥也还是个孩子，

en.t: Shinichi said, "At that time, my brother was still a child too,

units.source_text: 试问小孩子能抚养婴儿吗？”

en.t: so how could a child possibly raise a baby?"
